topic: How Fees and Expenses Affect Your Investment Portfolio
source_evidence: Does the product have more than one share class? If so, how do the fees compare across share classes?
question: Misconception: All share classes of an investment product have the same fees, so there is no need to compare them.
answer: Don’t assume the fees are the same. Compare costs across the product’s share classes, and ask which lower-cost class is available and what qualifications apply.
